NewTables.Create:
CREATE TABLE `offline_bot_craft_orders` (`OrderId` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COLLATE NOCASE, 
`BuyerBotId` BIGINT(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
`CrafterBotId` BIGINT(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
`Realm` INT(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
`CraftingSkill` INT(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
`ProductId` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COLLATE NOCASE, 
`ProductName` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COLLATE NOCASE, 
`RecipeLevel` INT(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
`Copper` BIGINT(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
`State` VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COLLATE NOCASE, 
`ItemObjectId` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COLLATE NOCASE, 
`CreatedUtc` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COLLATE NOCASE, 
`ExpiresUtc` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COLLATE NOCASE, 
`LastTimeRowUpdated` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT '2000-01-01 00:00:00', 
`offline_bot_craft_orders_ID` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COLLATE NOCASE, 
PRIMARY KEY (`offline_bot_craft_orders_ID`))

CREATE TABLE `offline_bot_quests` (`BotId` BIGINT(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
`QuestId` INT(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
`Active` TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
`Step` INT(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
`Finished` INT(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
`Abandoned` INT(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
`RetryUtc` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COLLATE NOCASE, 
`UpdatedUtc` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COLLATE NOCASE, 
`ParkedUntilUtc` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COLLATE NOCASE, 
`ResumeLevel` INT(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
`Parks` INT(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
`LastReason` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COLLATE NOCASE, 
`ParentQuestId` INT(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
`LastTimeRowUpdated` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT '2000-01-01 00:00:00', 
`offline_bot_quests_ID` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COLLATE NOCASE, 
PRIMARY KEY (`offline_bot_quests_ID`))

CREATE TABLE `offline_fishing` (`CharacterId` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COLLATE NOCASE, 
`CharacterName` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COLLATE NOCASE, 
`Skill` INT(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
`Casts` INT(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
`Catches` INT(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
`BestWeightTenths` INT(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
`BestCatchName` VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COLLATE NOCASE, 
`LastTimeRowUpdated` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT '2000-01-01 00:00:00', 
`offline_fishing_ID` VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL COLLATE NOCASE, 
PRIMARY KEY (`CharacterId`))
